It checks your writing against 33 documented patterns from Wikipedia's "Signs of AI writing" guide, drafts a rewrite, then audits that draft a second time to catch anything it missed before handing back a final version with zero em or en dashes. Give it a sample of your own writing and it matches your rhythm and word choices instead of settling for generic clean prose.
